task_description: Build ACIP Phase 2: the SEVEN core-path services (representation-service, ml-scoring-service, llm-gateway, decision-engine, payment-processor-sim, commerce-orchestrator, checkout-api) that make a transaction flow end-to-end and produce a decision WITH NO AGENTS and NO CLOUD CREDS. Fix the carryover KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP bug first (kafka:9092 -> redpanda:9092 in acip-common config + .env.example). Add a shared Kafka topic map to acip-common. Each service: own dir under services/<name>, Dockerfile (python:3.11-slim, uv, non-root), uv workspace member with path dep on acip-common, FastAPI app with /healthz+/readyz, 12-factor config via acip_common Settings, structured logging + trace_id propagation, pytest unit tests. REUSE acip-common everywhere (schemas, config, feature transforms, Kafka wrapper) - never redefine. Extend deploy/docker-compose.yml with the seven services (only checkout-api exposes a host port) without breaking the infra-only stack, and update the Makefile app-service targets. The six agents and graph-projector are Phase 3 and are NOT built here; the orchestrator reaches a decision via the deadline/decide_partial missing-verdict path. Locked: Python 3.11+, uv workspace, FastAPI+Uvicorn+Pydantic v2, confluent-kafka against Redpanda, checkout default mode sync, thresholds approve_max=0.35/challenge_max=0.70/fraud_block=0.85, weights 0.5/0.5 (from config), Neo4j5/Postgres16/Redis7, Ruff+Black+mypy+pytest, pinned deps, secrets via env only.
